The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1c4d90b5ed4de2ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. statement: Let M be a connected closed smooth oriented manifold. (i) If dim M > 2 and f : M → M satisfies f ◦ f ≃ f by free homotopy, then some self-map freely homotopic to f has exactly one fixed point. (ii) Choose x0 ∈ M and put G = π1(M, x0). If f : (M, x0) → (M, x0) satisfies f ◦ f ≃∗ f by based homotopy and f# = idG, then L(f) = L(2) ( e f). Here e f is the lift to the universal cover fixing a chosen point above x0; it is G-equivariant. The left side is the ordinary Lefschetz number, and the right side is the alternating sum of von Neumann traces on the induced L2-homology maps, as in [6, Definition 7.1].
